rollback retains a mode-only draft and permits returning to ordinary delivery
accepted stale input exposes explicit keep and retains its recovery command across an uncertain acknowledgment
rollback permits cancellation of an undispatched accepted input without exposing revoked sources
definitive precommit source rejection unlocks removal and ordinary resubmission
lost cancellation receipt stays retryable after its input disappears and the App reloads
formatted assistant text opens its exact canonical source even outside the bounded catalogue
deferred source view failure retains the mounted composer and restores focus
actual source modal and shared controls remain within the viewport at 200 percent zoom
native return waits for canonical placement and keeps delayed source work isolated between owners
